=== Duplicate copies the item with its subtree right after it
--- given
- a‸
  - a1
    - a2
- b
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- a
  - a1
    - a2
- ‸a
  - a1
    - a2
- b

=== Duplicate keeps the folds on the original and the copy
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - a1
    - a2
- b
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- a ⊟
  - a1
    - a2
- ‸a ⊟
  - a1
    - a2
- b

=== Duplicate keeps a fold inside the subtree on both
--- given
- a‸
  - a1 ⊟
    - a2
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- a
  - a1 ⊟
    - a2
- ‸a
  - a1 ⊟
    - a2

=== Duplicate copies the notes lines and the task box as they are
--- given
- [x] a‸
  a note
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- [x] a
  a note
- [x] ‸a
  a note

=== Duplicate renumbers an ordered list
--- given
1. a
2. b‸
3. c
--- when command duplicate
--- then
1. a
2. b
3. ‸b
4. c

=== Duplicate from the middle of the line puts the cursor at the start of the copy
--- given
- ab‸c
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- abc
- ‸abc

=== Duplicate on a nested item keeps the indent
--- given
- p
    - q‸
- r
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- p
    - q
    - ‸q
- r

=== Duplicate with whole items selected copies the run and selects the copies
--- given
⟨- a
- b
  - b1⟩
- c
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- a
- b
  - b1
⟨- a
- b
  - b1⟩
- c

=== Duplicate puts the cursor after the bullet when the box counts as content
--- given stick=bullet-only
- [ ] a‸
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- [ ] a
- ‸[ ] a
